purpose: Calibration and held-out RD screening only; never execute dataset scripts
fetch_status: Complete: 36 calibration and 38 held-out slices; source pins, rows, licenses and hashes in destination/provenance.json
revision_policy: Resolve and record a commit SHA before fetching any selected file. Record URL, file SHA256, revision, license text and selected row IDs in provenance.json. Fetch only selected parquet/JSON files, never a repository snapshot.
split_policy: Native train/test for GSM8K; deterministic SHA256 modulo 10 for chats, tools, MMLU and cross-language HumanEval task IDs; Wikipedia curated disjoint article/concept sets; agent trajectories use disjoint tasks AND repositories. See per-document group_id in provenance.json. Exclude duplicate document/text IDs globally.
export_policy: Exactly 8192 source-tokenizer tokens per calibration slice and 512 per held-out slice. UTF-8 formatted document prefixes joined with two newlines. At a Unicode token boundary a final newline/document separator may be required; it is explicitly recorded, never repeated source text. Record prefix character ranges. No requirement that 4096-token halves respect document boundaries: half stability must still be measured.

sources.selection: A bounded subset of train_sft messages and test_sft messages; include both user and assistant turns
sources.download_policy: Selected parquet shard only if <200 MB; otherwise stream a bounded row export and count actual received bytes

sources.selection: Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, Rust; group translated task numbers before split; canonical code and tests as inert text.
main; calibration train, heldout test; question and answer
Bounded rows including tool schemas, assistant calls, JSON arguments and tool results; deterministic disjoint conversation IDs

sources.split: Use auxiliary/dev/validation where available, otherwise deterministic disjoint test row IDs; render question, choices and answer text. Small domain probes, not clinical/legal/financial validation.

sources.selection: Daily-life, language, education, travel and civic articles. Curated disjoint article/concept sets across splits, native language scripts. Exact article revision content returned with IDs in one response. Language mapping is recorded per slice. FLORES and FLORES+ excluded: access gates and FLORES+ training-use restriction. No gated mirrors used.

sources.license: ODC-BY-1.0; retain database attribution (verify pinned card)
sources.selection: Public Chinese general conversations only: exclude toxic/redacted rows, PII patterns, cold/professional topics, long technical prompts and mostly non-Chinese text. Group normalized first user prompt across variants; retain conversation_hash and turn IDs; export only role/content, never user metadata.

sources.license: MIT dataset; retain underlying repository attribution for code excerpts
sources.selection: ticks shard 0; calibration mahmoud/boltons at 3bfcfdd04395b6cc74a5c0cdc72c8f64cc4ac01f; held-out andialbrecht/sqlparse at e57923b3aa823c524c807953cecc48cf6eec2cb2. BSD-3-Clause repository notices retained. Start at first assistant action, preserving terminal observations; commands are inert text.

Revision-pinned wikitext, mwparserfromhell 0.7.2 strip_code; bounded prefixes. Curated archaeology, folk customs and obscure history in English/Chinese; broad daily-topic language-matched references. Disjoint articles across slices and splits; oldid and contributors URLs retained.

sources.split: held-out only; no calibration rows from these subjects; preserve source row IDs and use disjoint source shards from other subjects

license_policy: Retain each source license and attribution alongside local exports. Check cards at pinned revisions before fetching. Do not redistribute raw corpus in the model artifact.

contrastive_policy.normalization: REAP divided by per-layer expert mean separately per slice/half for hot protection; raw hot REAP retained for RD layer sensitivity
contrastive_policy.general_reference: general_reference_en / general_reference_zh, matched by cold slice language suffix
contrastive_policy.never_routed: keep by default; hard-protected during fallback too
contrastive_policy.cold_languages: English/Chinese only; low-resource languages remain hot/protected, never cold
contrastive_policy.language_balance: Each cold English or Chinese slice uses its same-language reference with equal token budgets; audit topic contamination before calibration.
